subject.title: Feature/Fix: Add conservative lineage safety and promotion controls

question: Should this lineage stack remain shadow-only, or may successful promotion evaluation enable authoritative production totals?
rationale: The code can replace established production accounting with a new path whose aggregate accuracy improves but whose daily residuals remain material; tests cannot decide the acceptable rollout and accuracy policy.

options.title: Keep Shadow-Only
options.body: Land the reversible lineage comparison infrastructure without allowing it to become authoritative until broader runtime evidence establishes safe daily accuracy.

options.title: Allow Gated Authority
options.body: Permit authoritative lineage mode after exact-head fresh-cache, retained-cache, cancellation, rollback, and upgrade evidence satisfies the proposed promotion gates.

options.title: Pause The Stack
options.body: Hold this slice until both predecessor PRs are merge-ready and the final validation PR proves the complete integrated path.

recommendation.title: Keep Shadow-Only
recommendation.body: Land the reversible lineage comparison infrastructure without allowing it to become authoritative until broader runtime evidence establishes safe daily accuracy.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner is the best available authority for accepting a new production accounting and rollout contract.
